detailed_description: Excel Viewer opens XLS, XLSX, and XLSM workbook data locally in the browser up to 10 MiB. Switch between sheets, inspect cell addresses and cached values, toggle formula text, review merged ranges, sort or filter one column, and download the selected sheet as CSV. The file is never uploaded. Macros are never executed, formulas are never recalculated, charts are not reproduced, and complex formatting may not be fully reproduced.
usage_steps: Choose an XLS, XLSX, or XLSM workbook up to 10 MiB from your device.
Use the sheet tabs to select the worksheet you want to inspect.
Review cell addresses and cached values, or switch to formula text where formulas exist.
Sort or filter one column to narrow the visible rows.
Download the selected sheet as CSV when you need plain tabular data.
usage_examples: Inspect a two-sheet workbook without uploading it or opening a desktop office app.
Review cached formula results while checking the original formula text.
Filter a task sheet by one status column and sort a numeric column stably.
Export one selected worksheet as correctly escaped CSV.

faqs.question: Is my workbook uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. The workbook is read locally in your browser and is never uploaded.

faqs.question: Does the viewer run macros or recalculate formulas?
faqs.answer: No. Macros are never executed. Formula text and cached workbook values can be displayed, but formulas are not recalculated.

faqs.question: Will charts and formatting look like Excel?
faqs.answer: No. Charts are not reproduced, and complex workbook formatting may not be fully reproduced in the data table.

faqs.question: What does CSV export include?
faqs.answer: CSV export includes the headers and displayed scalar values from the selected sheet. It does not export or modify the original workbook.
